# `Q-12-21` — Listing Record Has No Title

> An inline `contents:` record has neither `title:` nor `path:`; the
> item renders with an empty title.

## What this means

A listing's `contents:` can name inline records directly, instead of
(or alongside) glob patterns matching project documents:

```yaml
listing:
  contents:
    - title: Get started
      path: download.qmd
```

The record *is* the item — there is no document behind it to fall
back on for a title, unless `path:` names one. This warning fires
when a record has neither: nothing tells the listing what to display,
so the item's title is empty.

## Why this happens

- The record was meant to be a short standalone entry (an external
  link, a call-to-action card) and `title:` was simply forgotten.
- The record was meant to overlay a project document — the author
  intended `path:` to supply the title from the document, but left
  `path:` out too, so there is nothing to derive a title from at all.

## How to fix

Add `title:` to the record:

```yaml
listing:
  contents:
    - title: Get started
      description: Download and install
```

Or, if the record is meant to link to a project document, add
`path:` — the item then falls back to the document's title (or the
file name, if the document has none):

```yaml
listing:
  contents:
    - path: download.qmd
```
